analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 41,510) / SMA200 (KRW 33,757): Mixed medium-to-long term trend, but above SMA200 maintains long-term bullishness.
· 52-week position (58.1%) + Current price level is historically mid-range.

· MACD histogram trajectory (302.7514→523.5777): Continuous improvement, signaling bullish expansion.

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance (KRW 38,775): Potential for strengthening uptrend upon breakout.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.75x): Below previous average, slightly reducing momentum confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry conditions met due to RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement.
